mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lessons (course_id, title, description, scheduled_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{scheduledAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE lessons SET outcome = #{outcome}, paid = #{paid} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, title, description, scheduled_at, outcome, paid FROM lessons WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY scheduled_at, id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM lesson_files WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.original_name, f.content_type FROM course_files f JOIN lesson_files link ON link.file_id = f.id WHERE link.lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY f.id
